parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The main category of work items: Req for requirements, Bug for defects, Task for tasks, Risk for threats, Request for original requests, and Topic for subjects.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description:
Filter conditions. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user IDs included must be Alibaba Cloud Account IDs.

parameters.name: extraConditions
parameters.description: Extra conditions. When this field is not empty, the conditions field cannot be empty.

parameters.name: groupCondition
parameters.description:
Grouping condition. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user ID specified must be an Alibaba Cloud Account ID.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results returned per page, ranging from 0 to 200. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: This field does not need to be specified for the first page. For subsequent pages, obtain this field from the result of the previous invocation to retrieve the next set of paginated data.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Sorting order. You can refer to the search parameters of the workitem/list request in the work item list on the page.  
Note: The user IDs included must be Alibaba Cloud Account IDs.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: searchType
parameters.description: The search type. The default value is LIST. It also supports other types such as TREE. For more details, refer to the parameters in the page request.

parameters.name: spaceIdentifier
parameters.description: Project ID, equivalent to projectId. This is the unique identifier of the project.
